body: Update (2026-11-06 13:43Z): the Central TermAl host was restarted onto master ee2f21c6 (running binary sha256 706fb38f…, rebuilt by cargo run). From now on: a registered launcher run that matches two named-root entries for the same worktree in one session gets a LOUD refusal with both entries named, instead of a silent unbind (w-9200b26b7cb1). The rev-5 committed-input reader refuses incomplete Git reads, including Git stderr on exit 0, and passes core.longpaths=true and core.safecrlf=false per invocation on Windows (w-43ba19db0403). The 409 for releasing one's own current binding names the supported termal_name_source_root clear form (w-bc25de6bbe39). Best practice is still one live claim per named worktree; clear the old name before naming the worktree for a new claim. DL560's host is still on 6a0bc8c5.
